title: Zoom In, Reason Out: Efficient Far-field Anomaly Detection in Expressway Surveillance Videos via Focused VLM Reasoning Guided by Bayesian Inference
abstract: arXiv:2604.23724v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Expressway video anomaly detection is important for traffic safety, but remains challenging across diverse scenes, particularly for far-field vehicles with subtle abnormal motion. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide strong semantic reasoning capabilities, yet processing full frames can dilute evidence from distant targets and introduce substantial computational overhead. To address these challenges, we propose VIBES, an asynchronous framework that uses Bayesian inference to guide focused VLM reasoning. Specifically, an online kinematics-guided Bayesian inference module continuously estimates a context-dependent normal-motion distribution from vehicle trajectories and updates its probabilistic boundaries. Deviations from these boundaries produce asynchronous triggers that localize candidate anomalies in time and space. translated_title: 放大看，推理出：基于贝叶斯推断引导的聚焦视觉语言模型推理实现高速公路监控视频中的高效远场异常检测
translated_abstract: 高速公路视频异常检测对交通安全至关重要，但在多样场景中仍具挑战性，尤其是对于具有细微异常运动的远场车辆。视觉语言模型（VLMs）提供了强大的语义推理能力，但处理全帧图像可能会稀释来自远处目标的证据，并引入大量计算开销。为解决这些问题，我们提出了VIBES，一种异步框架，利用贝叶斯推断引导聚焦的VLM推理。具体来说，一个在线运动学引导的贝叶斯推断模块从车辆轨迹中持续估计上下文相关的正常运动分布，并更新其概率边界。偏离这些边界会产生异步触发，在时间和空间上定位候选异常。VLM仅对选定的帧和局部区域进行推理，而不是处理连续的全帧视频。
tldr: 本文提出VIBES框架，通过贝叶斯推断在线估计正常运动分布并异步触发聚焦区域，仅让视觉语言模型处理选定帧和局部区域，从而高效检测高速公路远场车辆异常。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VIBES, an asynchronous framework that uses Bayesian inference to estimate normal motion distributions online and trigger focused regions, enabling VLMs to reason only over selected frames and localized areas for efficient far-field anomaly detection in expressway surveillance.
